name: reef-tank
description: An original aquarium screensaver for Roku

scripts.build: npm run art && npm run lint
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/roku.mjs deploy
scripts.deploy:release: npm run build && node scripts/roku.mjs deploy --release
scripts.zip: npm run build && node scripts/roku.mjs zip --release
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/roku.mjs package
scripts.preview: npm run build && node scripts/roku.mjs zip && node scripts/preview-server.mjs
